entities.name: Query protein 495 aa
observations: 495-aa query has N-terminal Peptidase_A8 domain at residues 15–154 and C-terminal LYTB/IspH-family domain at residues 179–456; sequence analysis does not establish a full-length function.

The C-terminal region aligns to Neisseria meningitidis IspH P65191 at 87.5% identity across 321 residues, covering query residues 174–494; the alignment leaves the N-terminal 173 residues unexplained.
No direct subcellular localization annotation was retrieved for the query; its N-terminal hydrophobic segments suggest membrane association, but localization remains an inference.

entities.name: IspH P65191
observations: Reviewed Neisseria meningitidis IspH (4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-enyl diphosphate reductase), EC 1.17.7.4, catalyzes conversion of HMBPP to IPP and DMAPP in the terminal MEP/DOXP-pathway step.
Reference annotations include 4Fe-4S cluster binding and biological processes of IPP/DMAPP biosynthesis and terpenoid biosynthesis; these describe the homolog and are not direct query annotations.

entities.name: Peptidase_A8
observations: Pfam PF01252 matched query residues 15–154 with i-Evalue 7.3e-41; this supports an A8-family peptidase domain but does not by itself establish substrate or activity in this query.

entities.name: LYTB IspH family
observations: Pfam PF02401 matched query residues 179–456 with i-Evalue 1.5e-102; strong homology to IspH-family proteins is supported in the C-terminal region.
